tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Window backdrop behind sheets and the title bar strip; never under text blocks.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The content pane: step bodies, lists, the day plan. Default ground for ink, ink-secondary and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebars and the onboarding step rail.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Group panels (Work, Life, Everywhere), callouts, chips and the toolbar strip. Cards sit on it in surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards inside a sunken panel, popovers, menus, sheets, the selected segment.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track on sunken and sidebar grounds (panels, callouts, the step rail), switch off-track, kbd caps.

tokens.name: fill-control-soft
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track on white grounds (surface, surface-raised: cards, choice cards, menus). One step lighter than fill-control so a control on white keeps low contrast; the track always sits one step darker than the ground it is on.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash on borderless rows and menu items.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and panel borders, the footer rule. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-faint
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside a card or table.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of text fields, selects, checkboxes and unselected chips: 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: line-button
tokens.usage: Border of secondary and destructive buttons. Softer than line-control: a button is identified by its label and white fill, not its edge. Buttons carry no shadow.

tokens.name: line-button-hover
tokens.usage: Edge of a hovered or pressed secondary or destructive button; the fill stays white on hover so the key stays apart from grey panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token, sunrise, sunrise-soft and the soft tints. The icon's horizon in light, its cream in dark.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Ledes, row descriptions and body copy under a title, on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, step counters, upcoming steps, footnotes; on every surface token and fill-control (4.7:1 there).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only; exempt from contrast, always paired with a disabled control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view (Continue, Done, Add) and checked controls. Vault slate in light, cream in dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill.

tokens.name: sunrise
tokens.usage: NOW and HERE only: the running task's Now card, the now-line, today's date pill, the current onboarding step. A fill, never text. 2:1 on white, so it always carries ink text or sits beside a second cue.

tokens.name: on-sunrise
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sunrise fill (7.6:1).

tokens.name: sunrise-soft
tokens.usage: Keyboard selection: the row the cursor is on, a drop target being hovered.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px, offset 2px over the ground. 3.6:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: The icon's rim. Brand compositions only (cover, store art, empty-state hero); not a UI color.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The icon's sun disc and rivets. Brand compositions only; in dark UI it arrives as ink.

tokens.name: horizon
tokens.usage: The icon's water line. Brand compositions only.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: The Work sphere: its panel header, sphere chip and icon. Text on surface, surface-sunken and work-soft. Never a button.

tokens.name: work-soft
tokens.usage: Work header icon tile and the selected Work chip ground.

tokens.name: life
tokens.usage: The Life sphere, as work is for Work. Not a state color: active and on use positive.

tokens.name: life-soft
tokens.usage: Life header icon tile and the selected Life chip ground.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Active and on states only: the `on` Tag (Active, On). Always with its check icon. Yellower than life; never a sphere or a button. 5.7:1 on positive-soft.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the `on` Tag.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Anything a model wrote or suggested: the sparkle mark, AI tags, the AI panel title. Text on surface and ai-soft.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: AI panel and AI tag ground.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs your eye but is not wrong: May send data externally, waiting 6d, no estimate, over free time. Always with the triangle icon or a word. Text on surface and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Caution tag and banner ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, conflicts, destructive actions (Remove workspace, Erase). Always with an icon or word. Text on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger tag and banner ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Plain information that is not a problem: a requirement or a tip about a row, such as the model an AI level needs. The info footnote on a Card, always with the info.circle icon. Text on surface and info-soft (5.8:1). Not Work blue: never a sphere or a button.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the info footnote.

tokens.name: ws-blue
tokens.usage: Workspace identity color: number badge, dot and ⌘ chip only. Default for a new Work workspace.

tokens.name: ws-green
tokens.usage: Workspace identity color. Default for a new Life workspace.

tokens.name: ws-plum
tokens.usage: Workspace identity color (not AI violet).

tokens.name: ws-copper
tokens.usage: Workspace identity color (not caution).

tokens.name: ws-graphite
tokens.usage: Workspace identity color for dormant or archive-like workspaces.

tokens.name: on-ws
tokens.usage: Number on a workspace badge, on every ws- color (5.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in body copy, always underlined. Slate in light; light blue in dark so cream links never read as body text.

tokens.name: traffic-close
tokens.usage: Title bar close light, system color; drawn only in mockups of the window.

tokens.name: traffic-minimize
tokens.usage: Title bar minimize light.

tokens.name: traffic-zoom
tokens.usage: Title bar zoom light.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: One per screen: the step or page title.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet and popover titles, the day header on iPhone.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The running timer on the Now card; tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Group panel headers (Work, Life, Everywhere), card titles that name a workspace, settings section titles. Bold body size, as in macOS Settings.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row and card titles (the Card head), one step above the 12px description they lead.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Ledes, paragraphs, list items. The macOS body size; never below it for reading text.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Every change kept for 90 days, outside your folders
styles.usage: Row descriptions under a headline, chip and tag labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta, footnotes, step counters. The floor: nothing is set smaller.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels above a list or menu, set uppercase in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, ticket ids (WEB-142), regexes, file names.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Segment gaps, a step list's row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a tag; title to description.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and chips; chip to chip.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row; card to card in a tight list; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card padding; card to card; icon column to text.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a step body; panel padding; between the two sphere columns.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between major groups; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Content pane gutter (left, right and top).

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on empty states and the welcome icon.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd caps, inline code, small tags inside rows, workspace number badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, selects, a segment inside its track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segmented track, step rows, menu items, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, choice cards, callouts, popovers, the Now card, the window.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Group panels holding cards (Work, Life, Everywhere) and sheets: 12 + its 4px inset reads concentric.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, switches, step marks.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The selected segment, the current step row, a switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets over the window (Configure a workspace).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the ground, then 2px focus.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside rows and cards, segments, chips; the macOS small control height.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and selects in footers and forms; the macOS large control height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Height of a Card's head row: the tallest small control (segmented control, select, field). Shorter controls center in it and move in from the right by half the difference to keep square insets.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in rows, buttons and chips; 18px in menu items, 20px in panel headers.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Onboarding step rail and app sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of ledes and paragraphs.
